test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Bombastic
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3) i.e. **"Plain".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bombastic**: (आडम्बरी) - Characterized by high-sounding language but with little meaning; inflated.

 
 
• **Example**: The politician's speech was bombastic and lacked substance.
 
 
 
• **Plain**: (स्पष्ट) - Characterized by clarity and simplicity; easy to understand or straightforward.
 
 
• **Example**: She preferred plain language that everyone could understand easily.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for "Bombastic" is "Plain".

Therefore, the correct answer is "Plain".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Essential**: (आवश्यक) - Absolutely necessary; extremely important.
 
• **Sarcastic**: (व्यंग्यात्मक) - Marked by or given to using irony in order to mock or convey contempt.
 
• **Rhythmic**: (तालबद्ध) - Having a strong beat with a pattern to it; related to rhythm.
